summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated October 7, 2026, reporting preliminary third-quarter 2026 revenue of US$106.7 million from metal sales of 25,030 gold equivalent ounces, including first deliveries from the Ravenswood gold mine in Australia. The company reaffirmed 2026 guidance of 100,000 to 110,000 GEOs, cited operating partner milestones at Northparkes, Kon, Johnson Camp and Tamarack, and scheduled its Q3 results call for November 4, 2026. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
